purpose: Teach: タックル/浪人/飛鳥/ピカソ/ボンド/リンカーン/フットサル/ヤクルト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラグビーのタックル練習で怪我されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So that customer told you about his rugby tackle injury, Aoi.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Gentle curiosity about what Aoi's learning. Warm rhythm without rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、現役の浪人生でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He mentioned he's studying to retake the university entrance exam, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slight surprise in the discovery. Noticing something new about a regular. Warm acknowledgment of Aoi knowing her customers well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、飛鳥時代の歴史小説がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he loves Asuka period historical fiction.
lines.style: Gentle noticing. Each discovery builds warmth between them. Soft cadence, like piecing someone together across time.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピカソの個展に行かれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He actually went to that Picasso exhibition last month.
lines.style: Small smile in the voice. Aoi adding her own observation. Easy, conversational rhythm. The comfort of remembering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジェームズ・ボンドの映画好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He has a thing for James Bond films too.
lines.style: Light, almost playful recognition. Mei seeing the tapestry of this person through Aoi's eyes. Unhurried, intimate in tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リンカーンの伝記を読まれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He was reading a Lincoln biography the other day.
lines.style: Continuity of voice. Aoi's careful attention showing through. Natural rhythm of sharing small, true details. Warmth without strain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フットサルチームに入ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And now he's joined a futsal team.
lines.style: Recognition dawning. Mei hearing the whole picture form. Gentle, wondering. A person becoming clearer through these small pieces.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヤクルトの試合をご覧になったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He caught a Yakult game recently.
lines.style: Soft, satisfied close. The final piece settling into place. Aoi's voice warm and certain. A gentle fadeout, like the conversation finding its natural rest.
